title: Fisetin Prevents Oxidized Low-density Lipoprotein-Induced Macrophage Foam Cell Formation.
authors: Varghese, Johnna F; Patel, Rohit; Singh, Mohit; Yadav, Umesh C S
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物非瑟酮抑制巨噬细胞泡沫细胞形成，涉及脂质代谢和NLRP3炎症小体，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合建模完全无关。
abstract: Foam cell formation is an important event in atherosclerosis. Fisetin, a bioflavonoid, has been identified to possess anti-inflammatory, antilipidemic, and anticancerous properties; however, its role as a lipid homeostasis regulator in macrophages, specifically in the presence of metabolic stressors such as oxidized low-density lipoprotein (oxLDL) is not well understood. In this study, we have investigated the role of fisetin in preventing oxLDL-induced macrophage foam cell formation. U937-derived macrophages were stimulated with oxLDL with or without fisetin for varied time points, and various parameters were assessed including cell viability by 3-(4,5-dimethylthiazol-2-yl)-2,5-diphenyl tetrazolium bromide (MTT) assay; reactive oxygen species (ROS) by dichlorofluorescin diacetate assay; lipid accumulation by Oil Red O staining; and expression of NLR family pyrin domain containing 3 (NLRP3), sterol regulatory element-binding protein (SREBP)-1, and associated downstream proteins 3-hydroxy-3-methyl-glutaryl-coenzyme A reductase (HMGCR) and fatty acid synthase (FAS) by quantitative reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) and immunoblotting. Functionality of FAS enzyme was determined using enzyme activity assay. Docking studies were performed to determine the in silico interaction between NLRP3 and fisetin. The results showed that fisetin up to the dose of 10 microM did not alter cell viability but at the same dose could decrease the accumulation of lipids in macrophages and prevented foam cell formation. Fisetin could also ameliorate and reduce oxLDL-induced upregulation of SREBP-1 and thereby the expression of its downstream lipid synthesis genes HMGCR and FAS and inhibited ROS-induced NLRP3 inflammasome activation. In conclusion, fisetin could inhibit foam cell formation by blocking oxLDL-induced ROS formation and subsequent NLRP3 activation, thereby inhibiting SREBP-1 and its downstream genes including FAS and HMGCR.
abstract_zh: 泡沫细胞形成是动脉粥样硬化中的一个重要事件。漆黄素（Fisetin），一种生物类黄酮，已被确认具有抗炎、抗血脂和抗癌特性；然而，其在巨噬细胞中作为脂质稳态调节因子的作用，特别是在存在氧化低密度脂蛋白（oxLDL）等代谢应激源时，尚未得到充分理解。在本研究中，我们探讨了漆黄素在预防oxLDL诱导的巨噬细胞泡沫细胞形成中的作用。将U937来源的巨噬细胞用oxLDL刺激，并加入或不加入漆黄素处理不同时间点，评估了多种参数，包括通过3-(4,5-二甲基噻唑-2-基)-2,5-二苯基四唑溴化物（MTT）法检测细胞活力；通过二氯荧光素二乙酸酯法检测活性氧（ROS）；通过油红O染色检测脂质积累；以及通过定量逆转录聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）和免疫印迹法检测NLR家族含吡啶结构域3（NLRP3）、甾醇调节元件结合蛋白（SREBP）-1及其下游相关蛋白3-羟基-3-甲基戊二酰辅酶A还原酶（HMGCR）和脂肪酸合酶（FAS）的表达。通过酶活性测定法评估FAS酶的功能性。进行了对接研究以确定NLRP3与漆黄素之间的计算机模拟相互作用。结果表明，漆黄素在高达10微摩尔剂量下不改变细胞活力，但在相同剂量下能减少巨噬细胞中的脂质积累并阻止泡沫细胞形成。漆黄素还能改善并降低oxLDL诱导的SREBP-1上调，从而减少其下游脂质合成基因HMGCR和FAS的表达，并抑制ROS诱导的NLRP3炎症小体激活。总之，漆黄素可通过阻断oxLDL诱导的ROS形成及随后的NLRP3激活，从而抑制SREBP-1及其下游基因（包括FAS和HMGCR）来抑制泡沫细胞形成。
